up: List all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) indicated for type 2 diabetes mellitus. Return the following columns: the drug's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the drug's preferred name (pref_name), the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) for the structure, the indication ID (drugind_id), the MeSH heading (mesh_heading), and the EFO term (efo_term).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.drugind_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading = 'Diabetes Mellitus, Type 2'
